name: Docetaxel
route_note: IV infusion every 1–3 weeks, with corticosteroid premedication to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity
owner: generic (many); Taxotere brand held by Sanofi

discovery.by: Pierre Potier and colleagues, CNRS Gif-sur-Yvette, with Rhône-Poulenc
discovery.note: Made semisynthetically from 10-deacetylbaccatin III extracted from the needles of the European yew (Taxus baccata).

tagline: Semisynthetic taxane used in breast, prostate, lung, gastric and head and neck cancer
summary: Docetaxel is a semisynthetic taxane that binds β-tubulin and stabilises microtubules more potently than paclitaxel. It was the first chemotherapy shown to extend survival in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and is widely used in breast, lung, gastric and head and neck cancer.
mechanism: Like paclitaxel, docetaxel binds β-tubulin and promotes microtubule assembly while inhibiting disassembly, blocking mitotic spindle dynamics and causing G2/M arrest and apoptosis.
It has higher tubulin affinity and longer intracellular retention than paclitaxel, and also induces Bcl-2 phosphorylation, which may contribute to apoptosis.
uses: Metastatic castration-resistant and hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (with prednisone or ADT)
Gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (e.g. FLOT, DCF)
Squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (induction)

history.title: Synthesis
history.detail: Potier's group at CNRS makes docetaxel from yew-needle precursors.

history.title: EU approval
history.detail: Taxotere authorised in the EU for breast cancer.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: FDA approves Taxotere for anthracycline-resistant metastatic breast cancer.

history.title: Prostate cancer
history.detail: TAX 327 shows a survival benefit with docetaxel plus prednisone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; FDA approval follows.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic docetaxel becomes available in the US.

history.title: CHAARTED/STAMPEDE
history.detail: Adding docetaxel to androgen deprivation prolongs survival in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

history.title: FLOT
history.detail: FLOT4 establishes perioperative docetaxel-containing FLOT as standard for resectable gastric cancer.

safety.boxed_warning: Boxed warning for treatment-related mortality (higher with hepatic impairment or high doses), hepatotoxicity, neutropenia, hypersensitivity and fluid retention.

facts: Docetaxel is about twice as potent as paclitaxel at inhibiting microtubule depolymerisation in vitro.
